crossRefs.note: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure…
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands…
crossRefs.keyword: another; meddling with other people's concerns

crossRefs.note: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
crossRefs.keyword: another; meddling with other people's concerns

crossRefs.note: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies…
crossRefs.keyword: another; meddling with other people's concerns

translations.web: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
translations.bsb: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
translations.kjv: But let ➔ none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
translations.asv: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men's matters:
